intended_object: An explicit (2k+1)-flute whose largest entry is the Fibonacci number F_{2k+1}, the maximum possible. Here an n-flute is a positive integer sequence with a₀ = 1, period n−1, and a_{i+1} ∣ a_i + a_{i+2}. Its period is 1, F₄, F₆, …, F_{2k}, F_{2k+1}, F_{2k−1}, …, F₃. This reading comes from the docstring and the definition of `aOdd`.
